## Schema checklist

<!-- If adding or modifying a schema, check the applicable items: -->

- [ ] Schema uses `$schema: https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema`
- [ ] Root `description` links to the official specification
- [ ] Every property has a `description`
- [ ] Descriptions use markdown (links, bold, lists) but not tables
- [ ] `required`, `enum`, `const`, and `default` match the specification
- [ ] Entry added/updated in `lintel-catalog.toml` with correct `file-match` patterns
- [ ] Schema file is at `schemas/<group>/<schema-key>.json`
